text:
Dawson Mercer gets his old team tonight. He played 420 games for New Jersey before landing in Winnipeg, and the Devils come to town on a run of nine wins in ten. His Jets career is eight games old, and his first goal for them was the winner in a 6-2 win over Vancouver.

His season line is quiet: one goal and eight points in 18 games, one goal on 3.5 expected (the quality of his chances), shooting 2.9% against a normal range of 10 to 14%. That's bad luck more than a slump; he's getting to good spots and Winnipeg has a slightly better chance share with him on the ice than without.

He scored 20 goals for New Jersey last season, and the bet Winnipeg made is that he gets back there. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 1.6 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net, the best kind. Our projection sees about 15 goals from here. His old team would make a fine opponent for the second one.
